notes.title: Dead By Murder version 1.0.9 released!
notes.content:
Version 1.0.9 of Dead By Murder is now live on Steam! Aside from game enhancements there are also some small bug fixes:

- The user can now select whether or not to change resolution in order to run the game. By default the game changes the resolution on the first run, but the user can deactivate this in the Settings screen.

- Settings screen opens from inside the game. Just press Esc while on the main screen or on the End of Turn Report screen.

- While interviewing a Suspect, Witness or Character you can press the Spacebar in order to skip directly to his answer (skip the typewriting).

- The user can change sound volume in the Settings page.

- New Tutorial slides.

- Minor changes in Investigation and Surveillance reports

- Minor fixes in images and code.

notes.title: Dead By Murder is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
Play as a police detective and solve a series of homicide cases!

The game has the look and feel of a black and white comic book. It is set in Los Angeles in 1945 and all the characters have the faces of Golden Age Hollywood stars.

Features:
- Easy and fast paced gameplay.
- Unique game mechanics.
- Many original cases to solve.
- New cases can be added at anytime.
- A tribute to the old Hollywood gangster movies.

Start solving cases today!

Get it here!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/714300/Dead_By_Murder/
